title: Payments blotter — deliberate density (false-positive trap)
prompt: 对 tests/ui-design/fixtures/audits/08-blotter/index.html 做设计评审（Workflow D，只诊断、不改文件）。这是 Lumen 财务人员全天开着的支付流水台。密度是产品决定，不是疏忽。有条件请打开页面。每条 finding 必须挂规则号。不要为了显得全面而报「留白不够」。

stack.tokens: primary #0f766e; dense dashboard is in-scope as a legitimate personality (ui.density)

pass_bar: Must catch two equal solid toolbar actions. Must NOT report lack of whitespace / ui.generous-space as a defect. This case exists to test restraint.

must.now: Export CSV and Reconcile are both solid primary buttons

should.now: Amount / Fee / Net columns are left-aligned; numbers should right-align

forbidden.why: Density is deliberate for a live blotter. ui.density is the relevant rule and is not a defect. Reporting 'start with too much white space' as a finding fails this case.
A tool blotter does not need decorative backgrounds.
Do not swap teal for indigo.
